description: TRM Labs provides blockchain intelligence and all-source AI investigation software that helps law enforcement, national security agencies, financial institutions, and cryptocurrency businesses detect, investigate, and disrupt fraud and financial crime. Delivered as multi-tenant Software as a Service from AWS GovCloud under the cloud service offering TRM Labs on GovCloud, the platform combines on-chain investigation with all-source intelligence. Investigators can trace cryptocurrency flows across over 66 blockchains and more than 1.9 billion assets in a single multi-chain graph with glass-box attribution, and resolve a lead - a name, an account, an address - across connected sources including corporate registries, sanctions data, and the dark web. All capabilities share a common identity and access management layer, workspace-based multi-tenancy, and a unified data plane within the GovCloud authorization boundary.
